verdict: One low-severity observability issue resolved and retested; no service defect in the reproduced 01:00–02:00 default scenario.

findings.claim: QA-01 (low, resolved and retested): The node power-state chart did not reveal busy versus immediately free active GPUs, leading to an incorrect perception of no reserve/downtime. The selected-minute panel now exposes occupancy, idle active reserve, warm standby and actual queue separately. Actual default replay had 23 idle active GPUs at 01:00, 28 at 01:10 while warm count was zero, and zero request waits.
